title: Bitbucket
summary: Versioned code, TTL, SPARQL, tests, and reviewable changes.

sections.label: Recommended use
sections.text: Keep relevant procedures and verification scripts near the code/data they describe. Link findings and PR evidence to exact revisions, including submodule revisions.

sections.label: Verified constraint
sections.text: GitHub Copilot cloud agent currently works with GitHub-hosted repositories. A Bitbucket checkout used in IntelliJ is a different execution route; do not assume GitHub’s cloud PR automation applies.

sections.label: Implementation path
sections.text: Use supervised IDE work or an approved runner that can operate on Bitbucket and your established pipelines. Repository migration is not a prerequisite of this proposal.

catalog.applicability: Use this Bitbucket example when source, tests and review evidence live in a Bitbucket repository and you need to know which agent route applies. GitHub Copilot cloud agent works with GitHub hosted repositories, so a Bitbucket checkout relies on supervised IDE work or an approved runner.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
